subject: Demo recap + scoped POC evaluation plan for Scoutly Health
messages:
From: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@scoutlyhealth.com>, Mark Jensen <mark@scoutlyhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-15T22:12:00Z
Subject: Demo recap + scoped POC evaluation plan for Scoutly Health

Hi Alicia / Mark,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great discussion and I appreciate the clarity on where Scoutly is trying to take provider intake and claims triage. Per our call, I put together a short, scoped evaluation plan that maps to the three priorities we discussed: 1) extract & normalize provider intake fields, 2) reduce manual triage steps by 40% on flagged claims, and 3) maintain PHI-safe inference in your US-only tenant.

Attached: scoutly_eval_plan.pdf (12 pages) — includes proposed success criteria, test prompts, sample data requirements, and a 3-week POC timeline. Also attaching a draft quote: redwood_poc-quote.xlsx.

Quick ask / next steps:
- Can you confirm the two success metrics we should measure? I suggested (A) 40% reduction in manual triage time and (B) >= 92% field extraction F1 on the sample set.
- Who will own the data prep and approval on your side? We recommend a single technical point of contact plus a clinical SME for acceptance.
- Are there any procurement gating items (PO/contract lead) we should loop in now?

Proposed kickoff: week of Oct 26 (3-week sprint: baseline -> model tuning -> acceptance). If that works, we’ll schedule a 60m kickoff and share the runbook.

Thanks — I’m copying Neha (security/SSO) and Marissa (onboarding) to coordinate internal owners.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
[Attachment: scoutly_eval_plan.pdf; redwood_poc-quote.xlsx]

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@scoutlyhealth.com>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Mark Jensen <mark@scoutlyhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@scoutlyhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-16T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo recap + scoped POC evaluation plan for Scoutly Health

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the doc. Quick notes after a brief internal sync: 

- The metrics look aligned, though our clinical lead asked if the extraction F1 threshold can be split by "structured intake" vs "free-text notes" (we suggested 95% for structured, 88% for free-text).
- Data prep: I can own sample selection and will ask our analytics lead (cc'd on follow-up) to deliver the 1,000-case sample by next Wed (Oct 22).
- Procurement: copying procurement@scoutlyhealth.com — they will need the SOW and an initial estimate for our spend planning.

Two items for security clarification before kickoff:
1) Will inference run in a dedicated US-only VPC?
2) What level of logs are retained and can they be disabled for PHI fields?

I’ll aim to confirm owners by EOD Tue. If you can update the plan to include the split success thresholds and a quick note on data residency/logging, that would be great.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Head of Product, Scoutly Health
alicia@scoutlyhealth.com

On 2026-10-15 at 22:12, KarThik Iyer wrote:
> Thanks again for the time earlier — great discussion...

From: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@scoutlyhealth.com>, Mark Jensen <mark@scoutlyhealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, procurement@scoutlyhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-17T18:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo recap + scoped POC evaluation plan for Scoutly Health

Alicia — thanks, that makes sense. I updated the attached plan to reflect the split thresholds and added a short security note: yes, we can run inference in a dedicated US-only VPC for the POC and we support field-level suppression in logs. Neha (security) added the retention options — Neha, see the notes inline and flag anything I missed.

To be explicit on owners:
- Scoutly: Alicia (product lead / sample owner), Mark (exec sponsor), procurement@scoutlyhealth.com (contracts)
- Redwood: Neha Kapoor (security & SSO), Marissa Cole (onboarding & runbook), KarThik Iyer (solutions / engagement lead)

Attached: revised scoutly_eval_plan.pdf, redwood_poc-quote.xlsx (updated with a two-tier pricing option).

Proposed kickoff: Tue Oct 27 10:00 AM PT — 60m runbook walkthrough. If that slot doesn't work we can do Wed morning.

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite once I get a confirmation.

Best,
Karthik
[Attachment: scoutly_eval_plan.pdf (v2); redwood_poc-quote.xlsx]

From: Mark Jensen <mark@scoutlyhealth.com>
To: KarThik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Alicia Ramos <alicia@scoutlyhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@scoutlyhealth.com
Date: 2026-10-18T16:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Demo recap + scoped POC evaluation plan for Scoutly Health

Karthik — this looks good. Alicia and I confirmed Oct 27 10:00 AM PT for the kickoff. Procurement will review the quote and follow up with standard PO terms; they asked for your initial contract contact to get the SOW moving.

Please send the calendar invite and a short agenda. One request: can the kickoff include a 10–15 minute overview for our security team on how PHI is handled and what options we have to disable logging? Mark will be on the call and Alicia will bring the analytics lead.

Thanks,
Mark Jensen
VP, Operations — Scoutly Health
mark@scoutlyhealth.com
[procurement note: procurement@scoutlyhealth.com will follow up with PO templates]
